course_title: Business Process Automation with Power Automate and Copilot Studio Agents
deck: Business Process Automation with Power Automate and Copilot Studio Agents-v7.0.pptx
design_principle: Concepts first, labs second. Every lab is preceded by the concept slides that explain it, and every concept slide names the lab where it is applied.

modules.title: Module 1 — Business Process Automation and Power Automate
Module 2 — Control Flow and Human in the Loop
Module 4 — Agent Flows, HTTP and the Boundary of Agency
Module 5 — Retrieval Augmented Generation
concepts: built-in knowledge versus external vector store

labs.title: Lab 0 — Environment Setup
labs.subtitle: Copilot Studio Training (Developer) environment
labs.teaches: One Copilot Studio Training (Developer) environment, with Dataverse and Copilot Credits, stands behind every later lab.

labs.title: Lab 1 — Trigger and Actions
labs.subtitle: Form to email confirmation
labs.teaches: A trigger starts a flow; actions consume the trigger's outputs as dynamic content.

labs.title: Lab 2 — Log to Excel
labs.subtitle: Log the enquiry, then send the email
labs.teaches: Commit before you confirm — the audit row is written before the acknowledgement is sent.

labs.title: Lab 3 — Leave Application Approval
labs.subtitle: The flow pauses for a manager
labs.teaches: A running flow suspends at the approval action and branches on the human decision.

labs.title: Lab 4 — Agents
labs.subtitle: Procurement, HR, Sales and IT Support
labs.platform: Copilot Studio agents + agent flows + SharePoint + Teams
labs.teaches: An agent is instructions, skills, knowledge, tools and connected agents — and only some of those are enforced.

labs.title: Lab 5 — Invoke Agents
labs.subtitle: HR Support Agent grounded in SharePoint
labs.teaches: Ground an agent in a permission-controlled SharePoint source, test its refusals, and publish it to Teams.

labs.title: Lab 6 — HTTP and Application Approval Agent
labs.subtitle: Marina Trust Bank customer onboarding
labs.platform: Copilot Studio agent flow + SharePoint + Outlook
labs.teaches: The boundary of agency — the AI decides what to do; deterministic actions do what must always happen.
labs.path: labs/Lab 6 - HTTP and Application Approval Agent/README.md

labs.title: Lab 7 — HTTP and Chatbot
labs.subtitle: Investment advisor chatbot
labs.platform: Copilot Studio + SharePoint knowledge + static website
labs.teaches: The agent alone — rules in the instruction, facts in the knowledge source, and a refusal it must never break.

labs.title: Lab 8 — HTTP and Human Review
labs.subtitle: Client rapport assistant with a Teams approval gate
labs.platform: Copilot Studio + Human review + Excel Online + Outlook + Teams
labs.teaches: Human in the loop — the AI drafts, and the workflow physically cannot proceed until a person approves.

labs.title: Lab 9 — RAG with Knowledge Base
labs.subtitle: Cook & Bake Academy, built-in knowledge
labs.teaches: RAG as a product setting — three nodes, no ingestion, and nothing you can inspect.

labs.title: Lab 10 — RAG with Pinecone
labs.subtitle: The same chatbot, with the levers back
labs.teaches: What the convenience cost — chunking, embeddings, dimension and top_k, back in your hands.
